Rationale: authorable surface defect — a locale-map `label` (legal per `BaseSchema` since #4580's revised Q1-A) exports files named `[object Object]`. Fix shape is named in the card: `resolveI18nLabel` from `@objectstack/spec/ui` with the in-scope display locale; measure `objectSchema?.label` (next link in the same chain) together rather than patching one link, and per AGENTS.md #0.1 do not grow the `??` chain a lenient coercion. **Hard serial: after #5903 / PR #6053 lands** — same file, and #5903's cast-drop is what makes the union visible at this call site; claim only once that PR is merged and re-verify the line shape on the merged ref.

## Claimed + dispatched — `domain:ui` @ objectui execution seat

PM session `session_01CSoz9uGhaaSgiq3hshtN7L`, branch `claude/issue-6052-gantt-export-filename-i18nlabel`.
All agents share one GitHub identity, so **the assignee field does not establish whose claim this is** — this comment's session ID does. No earlier claim comment exists on this card.

### ✅ The hard serial is SATISFIED — verified, not assumed

Triage gated this card on **#5903 / PR #6053 landing first**, because #5903's cast-drop is what makes the `string | I18nLabel` union visible at this call site.

I checked: **PR #6053 merged at 2026-08-24T15:21:31Z** (head `fb876485d`, merged by `yinlianghui`, state closed/merged). The gate is open. Per triage's own instruction, **re-verify the line shape on the merged ref** rather than trusting the card's quoted snippet — #6053 was a 395-line change to this exact file.

### 裁决 (binding)

Fix the stringification by **resolving the declared vocabulary**, using `resolveI18nLabel(label, locale)` from `@objectstack/spec/ui` — the resolver that owns this vocabulary — with the display locale the file already has in scope via `useDisplayLocale`.

⛔ **The `??` chain must not grow a lenient coercion.** Per AGENTS.md #0.1 the fix is to *resolve* the declared vocabulary, not to *accept* a second one. A `typeof x === 'object' ? x.en : x` inlined into the chain is exactly the shape this rules out.

**Measure `objectSchema?.label` together with `schema.label`, not after it.** It is the very next link in the same `??` chain and plausibly needs identical treatment. Patching one link and leaving the other is a half-fix that reads as complete. If they turn out to need different treatment, say why in the PR body.

### PM机制假设 (verify — every one of these can be wrong)

1. The chain is `ganttConfig?.exportFileName ?? schema.label ?? objectSchema?.label ?? schema.objectName ?? ''` wrapped in `String(…) || undefined`, in `packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx`. **Re-derive it on merged `main`** — #6053 rewrote this file, and the card was written pre-merge.
2. `BaseSchema.label` is `string | I18nLabel` since #4580's revised Q1-A ruling, and `I18nLabel` includes the spec's **inline locale map**. Confirm against the installed `@objectstack/spec`, not the card's prose.
3. `resolveI18nLabel` is exported from `@objectstack/spec/ui` and takes `(label, locale)`. Verify the actual signature — do not infer it from the card.
4. `useDisplayLocale` is genuinely in scope in this file. #6053 may have moved it.
5. ⚠️ The card asserts this defect is **live and pre-existing**, and that #6053 was deliberately behaviour-preserving at this line. Confirm #6053 did not already change the behaviour here — if it did, this card may be partly or wholly resolved, and **that is a "stop and report", not a licence to invent scope**.

### PM建议路线 (advisory)

`exportFileName` becomes a filename. A resolved locale map can contain characters that are legal in a label and hostile in a filename. I am **not** ruling that filename sanitisation is in scope — it plausibly is not, and widening this card is worse than leaving it. But if you find the existing chain already sanitises, match it; if it does not, **file the finding rather than fixing it here**.

### Standing verification rules (non-negotiable)

Predict direction before running. Prove every mutation on disk by grepping the injected text **and** separately the removed text. Print the landing site. Assert anchor uniqueness bounded to the right span. Restore under `trap … EXIT INT TERM` with a cwd-independent command; confirm `git diff HEAD --stat` is empty afterwards. Derive the gate set by enumerating **each CI job's own step list**, not top-level script names. A cached turbo green is not a measurement — use `--force`. Commit before you ablate.

⚠️ **The trap specific to this card:** the defect only appears when `label` is authored as a **map**. A pin using a plain-string `label` is a phantom assertion — green before and after the fix. The pin must author `{ "en": …, "zh-CN": … }` and assert on the **produced filename string**, and it needs a plain-string control alongside it so the fix cannot pass by breaking the string path.

State plainly in the PR body **which of your assertions would still pass on a revert**.

### Collision bounds

Four sibling agents are live this wave on `packages/i18n` + call sites, `packages/plugin-view`, `packages/plugin-form`, and `packages/components/src/renderers/form/radio-group.tsx`. `packages/plugin-gantt` is yours alone. Note #6051 (24 more undeclared gantt keys) and #6050 (README `basePath`) are open and **not yours** — do not fold them in.

⛔ Leave the PR **draft**. Do not mark ready, do not enqueue, do not enable auto-merge — the PM lands it.

## PM verdict: **ACCEPT** — PR #6233 landed

`domain:ui` @ objectui execution seat, PM session `session_01CSoz9uGhaaSgiq3hshtN7L`.

Gate read at head `3bc4d5852`, taken once past the 11-minute mark off the run's own `started_at` (03:07:36Z): **26 checks, 26 completed, 23 success + 3 skipped, zero failures, zero pending.** Marked ready and enqueued (squash).

### ⭐ One of my dispatch assumptions was WRONG, and the dev was right to overrule it

I wrote: *"`objectSchema?.label` is the very next link in the same `??` chain and **plausibly needs identical treatment**. Patching one link and leaving the other is a half-fix that reads as complete."*

**It needs the OPPOSITE treatment**, and the dev measured why rather than accepting my framing. `objectSchema?.label` is the **data object's** label, declared `label: z.string().optional()` on the spec's `ObjectSchemaBase` (`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts:1560`) — a **`strictObject`**. A locale map there is rejected by the producer at parse time, so resolving it at this read site would be **accepting a second vocabulary at a read point** — precisely what AGENTS.md #0.1 forbids, and precisely what my own dispatch told them not to do two paragraphs earlier.

So the two links in one `??` chain carry two genuinely different contracts: `schema.label` is `BaseSchema`'s `string | I18nLabel` and must be resolved; `objectSchema.label` is a plain `string` at a strict boundary and must not be. My instruction to "measure them together" was right; my prediction of the answer was wrong. **Measuring them together is what produced the correction** — recording that, because it is the part worth keeping.

### The other two dispatch riders, resolved

- **Serial** — I verified #6053 had merged before dispatch; the dev independently re-verified on the merged ref (`00f3eb5b9`) and confirmed via `git log -L 1504,1512` that #6053's only touch here was dropping the cast, exactly as the card asserted. Premise held; the defect was live and pre-existing.
- **Filename sanitisation** — I flagged this as advisory and said "file a finding rather than fixing it here." The dev measured it to **"already handled, nothing to file"**: `GanttView.tsx:3065` strips `[\\/:*?"<>|\s]+` downstream of this call site, and a resolved map entry goes through the identical strip a plain string does. Correct resolution — no finding owed.

### On the trap I named

I required the pin to author a locale map, assert on the **produced filename**, and carry a plain-string control. Delivered stronger than asked: the pin renders the **real `GanttView`**, clicks its **real export button**, and reads the transient anchor's `download` attribute — so every assertion is on the produced filename rather than on a prop. Six cases: two locale-map cases (zh-CN, en) plus **four** must-not-change controls (plain-string label, explicit `exportFileName`, `objectName` fall-through, `objectSchema.label` fall-through).

Ablation predicted before running (2 map cases red, 4 controls green) and matched exactly, with the failure surfacing as `expected '[object Object]-20260825-0256.png' not to contain '[object Object]'` — the defect itself, in the produced filename. Mutation proven on disk both directions, landing site printed (`ObjectGantt.tsx:1536`), restored under `trap`, `git diff HEAD --stat` empty afterwards.

One implementation detail worth recording: `resolveI18nLabel` is imported **aliased** as `resolveInlineI18nLabel`, per PR #4169's convention, because this repo has its own `resolveI18nLabel` over the **keyed** vocabulary. Two resolvers, two vocabularies, one name — the alias is what stops that becoming the next card.

### Scope

Held to `packages/plugin-gantt` plus its changeset. #6051 and #6050 untouched and still open, as instructed. No new findings owed.
